current_activity: The first units of the 256th VG Division reach Haguenau; the rest follow on 28 November
notes: Event date: CMH Riviera to the Rhine ch. 21 p. 386: "the first units did not reach Haguenau until 26 November, with the rest of the division following on the 28th". Event definition: the arrival of the first units on 26 November. Event support: one source family (CMH). Location: Haguenau with a precision of 10 km, named for the assembly area. Location approximate: a town point. Location support: CMH names Haguenau. Commander: unknown. Opponents: US XV Corps (Seventh Army). Context: CMH ch. 21 p. 378 says the division was to pass to the control of Corps Command Vosges on arrival; that was a plan, so no relation is recorded.
